title: SVGL
description: A beautiful, community-driven library of SVG logos for modern web frameworks, cloud infrastructure, AI models, and developer tools with quick copy and download.
features: Over 500+ crisp vector SVG logos for tech brands, tools, and platforms
One-click copy raw SVG code, React/Svelte component syntax, or download `.svg` file
Light and dark mode variants tailored for different UI themes
Public API endpoint for dynamic logo querying inside your own applications
Community contributions managed transparently via GitHub Pull Requests
pros: Saves hours hunting for clean, un-pixelated tech logos on Google Images
100% free and open source with clean vector coordinates
cons: Logo trademarks remain the intellectual property of their respective owners
Focuses strictly on tech/developer logos rather than generic utility icons
targetAudience: Frontend developers, technical writers, and founders building landing pages and portfolio stacks.
